card: This PR enhances the bip32derivs parameter in walletprocesspsbt and descriptorprocesspsbt to support string modes (add, preserve, and strip) in addition to existing booleans. Setting bip32derivs to false prevented adding new derivation paths but could not remove existing derivation metadata or global xpubs already present in a PSBT. The new strip mode clears standard BIP32 derivation paths and global xpubs from inputs and outputs, allowing users in collaborative multisig setups to sanitize key-origin metadata before sharing transactions. This resolves long-standing issue #30294.
evidence: Closes issue #30294 ('Setting bip32derivs to false with walletprocesspsbt includes bip32_derivs for outputs'), which noted unexpected retention of output derivation metadata.
Follows closed PR #30341 ('Permit Combiner to strip bip32_deriv information'), addressing metadata privacy in collaborative PSBT processing.
problem: Setting bip32derivs to false prevents new key derivation metadata from being added, but leaves any existing key-origin fields intact. In collaborative PSBT workflows, users wishing to sanitize sensitive derivation paths or xpubs prior to sharing the transaction cannot strip existing metadata using these RPCs.
summary: Extends the bip32derivs argument in walletprocesspsbt and descriptorprocesspsbt to accept explicit key-origin handling modes: "add", "preserve", and "strip", while retaining boolean values for backward compatibility. When "strip" is selected, a new helper removes global xpubs and legacy/Taproot BIP32 derivation fields from all inputs and outputs after processing.
